items.title: Ration coupons
items.content: A bundle of household ration coupons, clipped together and partly used.

items.title: Laundry ticket
items.content: A blue laundry ticket with a date stamp and no garment description.

items.title: Train timetable
items.content: A pocket timetable, creased along the evening departures. No route is marked.

items.title: Bus timetable
items.content: A pocket timetable, creased along the evening departures. No route is marked.

items.title: Cinema stub
items.content: A faded ticket stub from a neighborhood matinee. The seat number is barely legible.

items.title: Unsent postcard
items.content: A postcard with a picture of the riverfront. The address side is blank.

items.title: Grocery list
items.content: A short list in pencil: onions, soap, tea and matches. The bottom half is torn away.

items.title: Newspaper clipping
items.content: A clipping about a local football result, folded into quarters and yellowed at the edges.

items.title: Calendar page
items.content: A page from a wall calendar with a dentist appointment circled in red.

items.title: Dance hall ticket
items.content: A ticket for an ordinary Saturday dance. The entry stamp is half missing.

items.title: Library due slip
items.content: A library slip for a borrowed gardening book. The return date has been stamped.

items.title: Recipe card
items.content: A handwritten recipe for onion soup, stained with cooking oil.

items.title: Bus transfer
items.content: A used bus transfer with two punched holes and no legible route number.

items.title: Post office queue ticket
items.content: A queue ticket from the central post office. No service number is written on it.

items.title: Church fair leaflet
items.content: A leaflet advertising a neighborhood church fair held last month.

items.title: Weather almanac
items.content: A small almanac with several days marked as rainy in the margin.

items.title: Theatre program
items.content: A folded program from a touring comedy, with one corner used as a bookmark.

items.title: Parcel wrapping label
items.content: A detached parcel label with the address rubbed off and a postal stamp still visible.

items.title: Torn envelope
items.content: An empty envelope with a local postmark. The addressee line has been torn away.

items.title: Pencil note
items.content: A brief reminder to collect a repaired watch. No name or date appears.
